facts.summary: Phase 2b missed primary endpoint; development ceased, strategic options explored · Phase 2b · KPI-012 in persistent corneal epithelial defect · not yet approved

evidence.summary: did not meet the primary endpoint of complete healing of PCED as measured by corneal fluorescein staining. The CHASE trial also failed to achieve statistical significance for key secondary efficacy endpoints
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Study did not meet primary endpoint of complete healing of PCED at Week 8; secondary endpoints also did not achieve statistical significance
evidence.safety: KPI-012 was well-tolerated with no treatment-related serious adverse events observed
evidence.program_discontinued: KALA plans to cease development of KPI-012 and its mesenchymal stem cell secretome (MSC-S) platform.
